mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates above 6.5% signal a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY), a 25 basis point increase in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls over the prior three months indicates improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has trended upward over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 99.0 (relative to 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 99.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDP growth and housing starts indicate robust economic expansion, which elevates corporate profit expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 0.5% YoY and HOUST rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST rise > 0.5% (GDPC1 YoY, HOUST monthly), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (UNRATE < 5.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), a rise in housing starts signals potential overheating and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST rises > 0.5% in 1 month and the regime condition (UNRATE < 5.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) holds, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
